root_cause.text: A race condition exists in the serial core subsystem where `tty_port_link_device()` is executed after `uart_configure_port()`, allowing user-space to open the console device before `driver->ports[idx]` is populated.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `tty_port_link_device()` call to precede `uart_configure_port()` in `serial_core_add_one_port()`, and the CVE description shows a `tty_init_dev` warning triggered because `driver->ports[idx]` is NULL when user-space attempts to open the console during initialization.
